title: PMDD — the two-cycle record (Ritu, 36)
caption:
"Just PMS" is how PMDD gets missed for years.
DSM-5 wants daily ratings across 2 cycles — memory doesn't count (DRSP, 2006).
Save this for the week you don't feel like you.
Which cycle day hits hardest?
www.aiforheratx.org
#pmdd #pmddawareness #womenshealth #cycletracking #lutealphase

scenes.text: Two good weeks. Then I *hate* everyone.

scenes.text: Ritu, 36, rated her symptoms nightly and found out her hormones were *normal*.
phrases: She rated three symptoms every night, cycle day next to it.
her brain just reacts hard to the shift (NEJM, 1998).

scenes.text: Rate your top three symptoms 1–6 with the cycle day, every night for two cycles.
phrases: Write the cycle day beside them.
Two cycles of that, then bring the page to your doctor.
And walk 30 minutes most days — WHO asks for 150 a week.
